title: South Korea rises to No. 17 in FIFA women's rankings
caption:
South Korea’s women’s national team is celebrating its highest FIFA ranking in over three years. After a dramatic bronze-medal finish at the Asian Games, they’ve officially overtaken China in the global standings.

Source: Koreaherald - South Korea rises to No. 17 in FIFA women's rankings
